content.coverageNote: This assessment covers only the opening presentations and direct exchange, approximately 11:46–1:13:22, with the final complete reply included. Audience Q&A, the later closing statements, and the introduction are not assessed. A verified replay at approximately 59:26–1:09:10 is counted only once; timestamps refer to the original upload. Scores describe this limited excerpt, not the complete event.
content.captionCaution: English automatic captions contain recognition errors, especially proper names, and overlapping display tails. Do not penalize caption artifacts or silently improve quoted words. The physical replay is not a second move. Score only the approved scoped source. Hitchens adopts naturalism but is not assigned a complete positive theory wherever he only challenges a theistic inference. No excluded Q&A or closing may supply a premise, burden, concession, omission, or score effect.
